action.service_company.description: Charge one attempt then freshly authorize real company post/reversal

output.description: Independent usage and business stages, bounded result/receipt only on known company commit and handle reuse flags; Committed stage alone is not result.ok

errors.refused: Before-charge refusal, charged later authority/business refusal, separate usage/business unknown outcomes; no automatic retry/refund

preconditions: Trusted workspace/key/catalog/lifetime and both connection preflight; statically ledger.post permission
Current registered live service credential, active workspace and explicit allowed company membership
postconditions: Only known usage commit permits fresh company attempt, with no second consumption/headroom requirement
Same key hash and credential ID/stable subject live binding plus current rights precede protected receipt lookup
Company effects/receipt atomic, usage independent; original business key and explicit recovery policy govern uncertainty
external_effects: First control usage commit may remain despite later company refusal or failure
Company post/reversal/receipt commit under held fresh control writer; no product endpoint, real data/mail/deployment or automatic refund
